phase1_leaf_result.part87_scope: Official GitHub public-fork witness authority classification plus current own Part86 continuation.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Public-fork survival after target deletion does not remove the authority-separation requirement: same-principal forks remain deletable by the same rollback authority; independently owned forks move the anti-rollback root to a second principal/protected authorization domain.
phase1_leaf_result.narrowed_positive: Independent public fork + least-privilege Contents-write + durable incarnation binding is stronger against target deletion/rewind, but is not accepted because the independent owner/admin and authorization grant remain residual external/protected setup dependencies.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A provider- or protocol-enforced monotonic witness with no second administrator/principal dependency and Chat-native creation, authorization, recovery and incarnation binding.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Bounded GitHub public-fork witness authority classification; no universal impossibility claim.

continuation: Part88: execute exactly one bounded provider-retained Git-object witness leaf using official GitHub documentation plus own clean state only. Test whether a content-addressed commit/tree/blob in a public fork network can act as a minimum-generation/incarnation witness even after branch rewind or one repository/fork deletion, without requiring any independently administered repository. Required negatives: all repositories in the network deleted, fork network becomes empty, unreachable-object retention/garbage collection not documented, commit SHA discoverability after own-state rollback, force-push/ref deletion, upstream delete/recreate, and API/rate-limit interruption. Accept only if provider-enforced retention and discoverability are documented strongly enough that no second principal, richer/protected/manual step, finite monthly/trial/paid quota or incremental cost remains; otherwise persist the exact retention/discoverability gap.
